panels.description:
- USD: Standard deviation without correction
- CSD: Standard deviation with correction (Bessel's)
- RANGE: Max-Min value range
panels.title: Standard Deviation Statistics (Jitter)

panels.description: Rate of probe executions by probe type and execution result. `success` means the probe ran without an execution error, independent of target reachability.
panels.title: Probe Execution Rate

panels.description: Fraction of probe executions that ran without an execution error, by probe type.
panels.title: Probe Success Ratio

panels.description: Rate of probe cycles skipped instead of executed. `saturation`: the global concurrency budget was exhausted; `inflight`: the previous run for that target was still executing. Sustained non-zero values indicate a scheduling/concurrency bottleneck.
panels.title: Probes Skipped (saturation / inflight)

panels.description: Number of probes currently executing, by probe type.
panels.title: Probes In Flight

panels.description: Probe execution wall-clock duration percentiles, by probe type.
panels.title: Probe Duration (p50 / p95 / p99)

panels.description: Time a scheduled probe waited to acquire a concurrency slot before executing (p95), by probe type. Sustained non-zero values indicate a scheduling/concurrency bottleneck.
panels.title: Probe Queue Wait (p95)

panels.description: Time since the most recent completed probe, by probe type. A value that keeps climbing indicates the scheduler has stalled for that type.
panels.title: Time Since Last Completed Probe

panels.description: Duration of a single collector Collect() call (p95), by collector. Rising values indicate the /metrics scrape path is becoming a bottleneck.
panels.title: Collector Scrape Duration (p95)
